entries.capability: Create sale with fixed amount and optional immutable item lines
entries.evidence_notes: createSale validates positive integer amount/currency and stores item snapshots; UI exposes two sample USD items and manual amount entry.
entries.limitations: No configurable product catalog, sale revisions, or full canonical basket contract.

entries.capability: Select quantity for two sample products
entries.evidence_notes: UI has two hard-coded sample items and basket review. Plan explicitly calls these a two-item sample cart.
entries.limitations: No catalog CRUD, inventory linkage, product import, modifiers, tax, discount, or tip.

entries.capability: Compute sample basket totals using integer minor units
entries.evidence_notes: Basket multiplication and aggregation use exact integer operations; ledger checks item total equals sale total.
entries.limitations: No configurable tax, discounts, tips, or immutable quote terms.

entries.capability: Convert USD amount to sats using fixed developer quote
entries.evidence_notes: Checkout code uses fixed REGTEST_USD_MINOR_PER_BTC; app calls it fixed developer test data.
entries.limitations: No live pricing source or production quote/expiry guarantee.

entries.capability: Fetch and apply live market rates in standalone checkout
entries.evidence_notes: Reviewed checkout uses fixed test quote, while rates crate supplies rate primitives/providers.
entries.workflow_scope: Standalone checkout vs shared rates engine
entries.limitations: No inspected integration of live rate source into checkout.

entries.capability: Persist immutable item name, unit amount, and quantity snapshots
entries.evidence_notes: SaleItem is snapshotted and sale creation verifies its item total.
entries.limitations: Tax, modifiers, discounts, and price-history contract are absent from this snapshot.

entries.capability: Persist Bitcoin attempt identity and quote/request reference before receiving
entries.evidence_notes: beginBitcoinAttempt records attempt ID, expected amount/sats, quote ID/time, and counter index before receiver invocation.
entries.limitations: App is marked Regtest only; no mainnet or merchant shift validation.

entries.capability: Track partial, confirmed, reorged, late, and overpaid evidence
entries.evidence_notes: Ledger retains Bitcoin evidence and derives payment state; UI flags review/late conditions.
entries.limitations: No mainnet validation; not equivalent to a production canonical commerce lifecycle.

entries.capability: Persist stable provider id before invoking card SDK
entries.evidence_notes: Checkout ledger supports stable card provider identifiers; optional Square bridge is isolated in debug Sandbox module.
entries.limitations: Production eligibility, physical reader, country/account/device support unproven.

entries.capability: Represent card pending, approved, completed, canceled, failed and unknown outcomes
entries.evidence_notes: Card states and evidence are modeled; scoped Sandbox reconciliation code is present.
entries.limitations: Does not establish production adapter reliability or production reconciliation.

entries.capability: Record manually acknowledged USD cash amount applied
entries.evidence_notes: CashPayment stores applied/tendered/change values; UI asks cashier to confirm physical receipt.
entries.limitations: USD cash only; manual operator acknowledgment, no drawer verification.

entries.capability: Preview and record change due for cash tender
entries.evidence_notes: UI computes remaining amount and change; ledger validates cash tender and persists values.
entries.limitations: No drawer integration, cash count, or non-USD cash handling.

entries.capability: Durably persist cash tender as part of local sale state
entries.evidence_notes: Cash mutation shares atomic local ledger writes and restart state; plan cites cash/restart checks.
entries.limitations: No opening float, cash-in/out, shift accounting, or cash refund support.

entries.capability: Combine recorded cash with Bitcoin/card attempt amounts
entries.evidence_notes: Sale tracks remaining balance across tenders and UI offers cash/card actions for an unpaid remainder.
entries.limitations: Complex partial/unknown/refund and canonical sale reconciliation remain incomplete.

entries.capability: Initialize local event epoch and snapshot current sales
entries.evidence_notes: initializeEvents commits epoch and current sale versions; local event data is internal checkout ledger.
entries.limitations: Not a versioned merchant event API or owner Requests API.

entries.capability: Read local event pages with cursor, floor, and resync indication
entries.evidence_notes: readEvents handles epoch mismatch/expired cursor with resyncRequired; benchmark notes bounded snapshot/replay.
entries.limitations: Bounded journal is not webhook delivery or external merchant integration contract.

entries.capability: Write ledger state atomically and detect uncertain outcomes
entries.evidence_notes: Nio storage writes temp file, forces contents, atomic-renames, then forces parent; uncertain outcome poisons/reloads state.
entries.workflow_scope: JVM/desktop storage implementation with Android adapter expected
entries.limitations: Does not establish Android power-loss behavior or full device recovery.

entries.capability: Reload locally persisted sale state after restart
entries.evidence_notes: Ledger decodes durable local state; plan says Android restart/history checks passed.
entries.limitations: No Box/backup restore, device-loss recovery, or full physical merchant workflow.

entries.capability: Search sale IDs and immutable item names
entries.evidence_notes: searchSales filters query against sale ID/item names, sorted by time; native UI exposes Sales.
entries.limitations: No customer/order-reference search or broad audit attribution.

entries.capability: Filter history by Bitcoin, card, or cash tender presence
entries.evidence_notes: HistoryTender includes all three; matching reports recorded attempts/payment, not income.
entries.limitations: Presence is not final settlement or revenue report.

entries.capability: Filter paid, unpaid, or owner-review sales
entries.evidence_notes: Status filter prioritizes requiresReview, then paid/unpaid.
entries.limitations: No advanced exception and fulfillment lifecycle reporting.

entries.capability: Filter sale history by inclusive/exclusive timestamps
entries.evidence_notes: History query supports fromInclusive/untilExclusive.
entries.limitations: No timezone/day-close report in this screen.

entries.capability: Create privacy-limited receipt projection from sale record
entries.evidence_notes: Projection contains item/tender/refund and payment status facts; strips controls from names.
entries.limitations: Projection/test text only; not proof of issued receipt.

entries.capability: Format stable plain text receipt for display/test
entries.evidence_notes: receiptText formats supported USD/SAT amounts using integer units; app renders receipt-like screen.
entries.limitations: No physical printing, email, or network delivery.

entries.capability: Record refund request against original payment attempt
entries.evidence_notes: App explicitly states recording request does not send Bitcoin or issue Square refund; ledger records request state.
entries.limitations: No customer claim-link/API flow, settlement, or provider refund invocation.

entries.capability: Track externally paid refund evidence separately from request
entries.evidence_notes: RefundEvidence and refund state track paid minor/sats, pending, and actual paid values.
entries.limitations: External owner evidence input is not an automatic payout.

entries.capability: Create and authorize on-chain returns in legacy owner/counter flow
entries.evidence_notes: Existing request/return and owner-counter flows include refund engine behavior with scoped E2E record.
entries.limitations: Not integrated into standalone checkout claim-link or refund payout UI.

entries.capability: Issue and reconcile a cash refund from standalone sale
entries.evidence_notes: Standalone plan explicitly leaves cash refund support outside current cash implementation.
entries.limitations: No cash return operation evidenced in checkout ledger.

entries.capability: Store and query owner payment requests and associated facts
entries.evidence_notes: Shared Requests crate provides ledger, model/list and returns modules.
entries.limitations: Not the standalone checkout data model or a documented merchant API contract.

entries.capability: Maintain counter-side payment/request records
entries.evidence_notes: Counter node owns legacy request/payment records and has scoped counter E2E evidence.
entries.limitations: Does not establish standalone native checkout integration.

entries.capability: Reserve or decrement inventory once per sale
entries.evidence_notes: Reviewed native sale schema has no stock fields; plan lists inventory-once as remaining work.
entries.limitations: No inventory ledger or idempotent stock workflow demonstrated.

entries.capability: Create/edit reusable products and catalog
entries.evidence_notes: UI labels sample catalog and says no provider catalog/inventory connected; plan identifies configurable catalog as backlog.
entries.limitations: Only sample products inspected; no CRUD workflow.

entries.capability: Configure or calculate sales tax
entries.evidence_notes: Native sale has amount/items without tax fields; plan leaves tax/modifier engine as remaining work.
entries.limitations: No tax workflow demonstrated.

entries.capability: Apply discounts or tips to basket total
entries.evidence_notes: Reviewed cart model tracks product, unit price and quantity only; plan lists discounts/tips as backlog.
entries.limitations: No such checkout controls demonstrated.

entries.capability: Authenticate cashier/manager/owner roles in checkout
entries.evidence_notes: Core capability type is verified metadata; plan says role screens and permission matrix remain backlog.
entries.workflow_scope: Shared metadata primitive vs standalone app
entries.limitations: Pure metadata is not authentication, staff screens, or enforcement.

entries.capability: Represent verified authorization, revocation, expiry and exact store/register scope
entries.evidence_notes: Core capabilities model pure verified metadata scoped to store/register.
entries.limitations: No authenticated transport, staff UI, or proof checkout actions enforce metadata.

entries.capability: Export guarded reconciliation CSV with satoshi amounts and timestamps
entries.evidence_notes: Books reconciliation export records exact satoshi amounts/timestamps and requires payment-disclosure acknowledgment per implementation addendum.
entries.limitations: Not complete accounting/day-close report; accountant export narrower.

entries.capability: Aggregate book totals by UTC or local day
entries.evidence_notes: Books supports UTC/local day totals, currency and tips fields.
entries.limitations: Does not constitute standalone checkout closeout screen or cash reconciliation workflow.

entries.capability: Open/close shift, count drawer, and review discrepancy
entries.evidence_notes: Plan lists opening float, cash-in/out, count, close, discrepancy review as remaining.
entries.limitations: No shift accounting/day-close workflow demonstrated.

entries.capability: Support physical receipt printer, drawer, barcode scanner or display
entries.evidence_notes: Standalone plan requires a tested capability matrix; receipt code is projection only.
entries.limitations: No physical peripheral support evidenced in inspected files.

entries.capability: Run optional Square Mobile Payments SDK virtual Sandbox flow
entries.evidence_notes: Sandbox module implements optional virtual card flow; documentation explicitly limits scope to Sandbox.
entries.limitations: Not production card acceptance, reader validation, eligibility, or privacy approval.

entries.capability: Create/observe Lightning receiving requests using configured node engines
entries.evidence_notes: Shared node/invoice types support Lightning receiving interfaces.
entries.limitations: Does not prove standalone checkout integration, funds/capacity readiness, or provider uptime.

entries.capability: Assess point-in-time confirmed funding and strict/lazy queue status
entries.evidence_notes: Node::receiving_assessment reports current confirmed-funding and strict/lazy-queue status.
entries.limitations: Assessment is not a route or capacity guarantee and not all receiver readiness.

entries.capability: Require confirmed funding before selected receiving mode
entries.evidence_notes: Funding gate exists in configured Lightning flows and specific tested paths.
entries.limitations: Does not establish every receiver mode, route, liquidity, backup freshness, or independent exit readiness.

entries.capability: Estimate UTXO spend/consolidation costs and report threshold advisories
entries.evidence_notes: Maintenance advisory estimates fees and identifies uneconomic outputs; explicitly advisory.
entries.limitations: No automatic coin selection, consolidation, transaction signing, or execution.

entries.capability: Plan transaction inputs, outputs, fees, and change for owner spending
entries.evidence_notes: Spend crate plans and validates transactions for explicit wallet requests.
entries.limitations: Not checkout receive automation or autonomous UTXO maintenance.

entries.capability: Create/restore Box-based wallet backup artifacts in legacy owner/counter workflow
entries.evidence_notes: Box packaging and legacy owner/counter backup/restore workflows have scoped evidence.
entries.limitations: Does not establish standalone checkout ledger backups, device-loss recovery, or Lightning channel-state recovery.

entries.capability: Restore standalone checkout ledger after loss or stale backup
entries.evidence_notes: Checkout ledger is local; plan says Box/device-loss recovery remains incomplete.
entries.limitations: Android backup rules and local ledger persistence do not prove tested restore drill.

entries.capability: Publish merchant webhooks from owner request or local events
entries.evidence_notes: Benchmark explicitly treats outward webhooks as optional adapter; inspected checkout events are local ledger only.
entries.workflow_scope: No webhook path identified in inspected scope
entries.limitations: No delivery/retry/signing endpoint established.

entries.capability: Operate hosted/online unattended checkout workflow
entries.evidence_notes: Plan defines standalone retail product first; online/unattended workflows are separately deferred.
entries.limitations: No public listener or hosted checkout workflow demonstrated.

entries.capability: Connect existing POS vendors to OpenBMT payment operations
entries.evidence_notes: Existing WooCommerce and Odoo integration code and historical scoped test documentation exist. Odoo README describes Odoo 18.0 Community tests with a stand-in Box; WooCommerce standalone/E2E documentation describes WordPress stand-ins. Plan defers broader POS adapters until standalone shift gates.
entries.limitations: Specific historical adapter scope with stand-ins, not live multi-vendor/merchant/hardware validation, universal POS parity, or proof of multi-location operations.

unassessed_domains: Detailed pricing/plan/country coverage of third-party card providers
Every historical owner/counter workflow beyond the cited scoped E2E artifacts
Full backup/restore behavior under device loss and Lightning channel recovery
External integration protocol coverage beyond inspected WooCommerce and Odoo artifacts
